figures.caption: TABLE II DECLARED OPERATING ENVELOPE AND EXPECTED FAILURE MODES.

Fig. 1. Operating characteristics on the magnitude-swept public audit (250 sequences, primary scope). The shaded band marks the FPR ≤ 0.05 falsealarm budget. Baselines are swept over their native scalar statistics; the full state machine is swept along a monotone fourteen-point threshold path, so its curve ends at the recall ceiling of its most sensitive configured setting.
